Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says it attacked US air defence radar systems at Bahrain’s al-Rafa and Awali airbases. Bahraini authorities say an industrial facility was hit and have condemned the attacks.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said there was “no threat to Mecca” after Saudi Arabia issued a danger alert for the Mecca province before lifting it moments later, as the Iran-backed group’s strikes on the Saudi kingdom stretch into another night.
